info.name: ChainSight API — Full Demo
info.description:
Agentic Supply Chain Intelligence — ChainSight Backend

Base URL: http://localhost:8000

QUICK START:
1. Reset State
2. Open SSE Stream (GET /api/stream/demo-session-001)
3. Run any Analyze request
4. Watch tool_call / tool_result events live

SOURCE TYPES:
  csv_json      → structured data, inventory counts, metrics
  pdf_report    → PDF text or long-form reports (paste text or give URL)
  news_article  → news/media reports about disruptions
  dashboard     → ERP/TMS dashboard snapshots
  realtime_feed → live alerts, IoT feeds, port authority updates

CONFLICT DETECTION:
  Send 2+ sources with contradicting numbers for the same metric.
  e.g. one says delay 3 days, another says delay 7 days.
  Parser scores credibility: realtime(0.92) > dashboard(0.85) > news(0.80) > pdf(0.75) > csv(0.70)
  Resolution logged in parsed.contradictions[]

request.description:
Open BEFORE calling POST /api/analyze.
Events: orchestrator_start, tool_call, tool_result, orchestrator_done, pipeline_done, pipeline_error
Set Postman request timeout to 0.

Pass a URL in content — backend fetches and extracts text automatically.
Also works with direct .pdf URLs (requires pypdf).

3 sources all agree — merger combines and ranks credibility:
  realtime_feed: ~0.92  dashboard: 0.85  news: 0.80
No contradictions in parsed.contradictions[]

CONFLICT DEMO:

CONFLICT 1 — Strike duration (delay_days metric):
  realtime_feed (06:00, credibility 0.92): 7-10 days
  news_article  (18:00 prev day, credibility penalised ~0.60): 2-3 days
  RESOLUTION: realtime_feed preferred (newer + higher credibility)

CONFLICT 2 — Delay days:
  csv_json (02:00, credibility 0.70): 3 days
  dashboard (05:30, credibility 0.85): 7 days
  RESOLUTION: dashboard preferred (more recent, higher credibility)

Check parsed.contradictions[] in response for full resolution log.
